status: Planned acceptance specification; cases are not claimed as executed.

cases.title: Open Studio offline
cases.setup: Packaged assets and a local test host are available without Internet.
cases.expected_outcome: Shell and permitted catalog load without CDN, cloud login, telemetry, provider calls, or Node.js runtime.

cases.title: Import is inert
cases.setup: A valid graph references expensive operations.
cases.expected_outcome: No mathematical command, upload, provisioning, grant action, or preview session is issued.

cases.title: Missing workflow host
cases.setup: Host provides catalog and standalone operations only.
cases.action: Open a multi-node draft and inspect Run.
cases.expected_outcome: Authoring remains usable; workflow execution is explicitly unavailable; no sequence of operation calls occurs.

cases.title: Base library isolation
cases.setup: Studio is not installed.
cases.action: Import and use the base MathKernel package.
cases.expected_outcome: No UI/JavaScript/provider dependencies or UI assets are required.

cases.title: No discovery scans
cases.setup: Fresh connection configuration has one explicit host.
cases.action: Start Studio and open connection settings.
cases.expected_outcome: Only the selected host is contacted; no LAN, SSH, or provider scanning occurs.

cases.title: Fixture-host disclosure
cases.setup: The development fixture host is selected.
cases.expected_outcome: A persistent Test host label remains; fixture results are not presented as real MathKernel execution.

cases.title: Partial port metadata
cases.setup: A descriptor lacks cardinality and requiredness.
cases.action: Add the capability and inspect its ports.
cases.expected_outcome: Missing semantics are labelled unresolved; no invented required port or guaranteed compatibility appears.

cases.title: Unavailable engine
cases.setup: Catalog advertises an operation whose optional engine is absent.
cases.expected_outcome: Documentation remains available; execution is unavailable with reason; no installation begins.

cases.title: Schema drift
cases.setup: A saved node uses schema digest A; the host now provides B.
cases.expected_outcome: Affected node requires review; connections are not remapped by position; old plan is invalidated.

cases.title: Removed operation
cases.setup: A draft refers to an operation missing from the scoped catalog.
cases.expected_outcome: An unresolved placeholder preserves original identity/settings; no replacement is silently chosen.

cases.title: Catalog script injection
cases.setup: Descriptor prose, icon and widget fields contain script/URL payloads.
cases.expected_outcome: Text is escaped; icons/widgets use allowlisted identifiers; no remote code/resource loads.

cases.title: Permission-filtered catalog
cases.setup: Two workspaces have different authorized entries.
cases.expected_outcome: Catalog caches and selections are scoped; inaccessible entries or details do not leak.

cases.title: Layout-only revision
cases.setup: A validated draft is unchanged mathematically.
cases.expected_outcome: Only presentation revision changes; operation/input bindings stay identical.

cases.title: Semantic edit revision
cases.setup: A validated draft has an approved threshold.
cases.action: Change the threshold text and commit.
cases.expected_outcome: Draft revision changes; related validation/plan is stale; an active run remains unchanged.

cases.title: Rename stability
cases.setup: Two nodes are wired and linked to past runs.
cases.expected_outcome: Stable IDs and historical result mappings do not change.

cases.title: Duplicate ID remapping
cases.setup: A selection contains internal edges and an external input.
cases.expected_outcome: Fresh IDs and internal remaps are exact; external binding is explicit, not guessed.

cases.title: Cross-host ID collision
cases.setup: Host B has an object ID equal to a Host A object ID.
cases.action: Import an A-bound document while connected to B.
cases.expected_outcome: Binding remains unresolved until authorized rebinding; ID equality does not grant access.

cases.title: Host-binding spoof
cases.setup: Editor JSON includes a plausible historical host reference.
cases.expected_outcome: Reference is non-authoritative and re-resolved; it cannot supply evidence or permission.

cases.title: Integer beyond binary safe range
cases.setup: Input value is 9007199254740993 as canonical text.
cases.action: Edit, save, reload, copy and submit through fixture validation.
cases.expected_outcome: Every operation preserves the exact decimal string without conversion to Number.

cases.title: Large rational
cases.setup: Numerator and denominator each contain thousands of digits.
cases.expected_outcome: Canonical text survives exactly; no numeric overflow, scientific-notation rewrite, or truncation.

cases.title: Zero denominator
cases.setup: A rational draft has denominator 0.
cases.expected_outcome: Draft is recoverable; explicit error blocks submission; no Infinity conversion occurs.

cases.title: Dutch decimal comma
cases.setup: Numeric input uses 1,25 in a locale-sensitive field.
cases.action: Commit it under supported and unsupported locale modes.
cases.expected_outcome: Interpretation is explicit and previewed or rejected; it never silently becomes two values.

cases.title: Missing versus null versus zero
cases.setup: Field states are unset, null, blank text, and zero.
cases.expected_outcome: Distinct states survive according to schema; defaults are not silently substituted.

cases.title: Display precision isolation
cases.setup: An accepted result has a small nonzero residual.
cases.expected_outcome: Only display changes; rounded value is identified and full residual remains available.

cases.title: Atomic reconnect cancel
cases.setup: An existing edge is being rewired.
cases.action: Cancel or drop onto an invalid target.
cases.expected_outcome: Original edge remains; undo history has no partial disconnect.

cases.title: Undo without effects
cases.setup: An edited graph has a submitted run.
cases.action: Undo and redo recent draft edits.
cases.expected_outcome: Only draft/presentation changes occur; run is not cancelled, replayed, or reauthorized.

cases.title: Delete visual group
cases.setup: A frame contains nodes referenced by a past run.
cases.expected_outcome: Member nodes and host objects/results remain intact.

cases.title: Single-input replacement
cases.setup: A destination has one occupied nonvariadic input.
cases.expected_outcome: Explicit Replace is required; no silent rewiring.

cases.title: Form shortcut protection
cases.setup: An expression textarea has focus.
cases.action: Press Delete, Enter, Escape and an IME composition sequence.
cases.expected_outcome: Text editing is preserved; no accidental node deletion, run, or approval occurs.

cases.title: Click-only authoring
cases.setup: Pointer dragging is unavailable.
cases.action: Add, connect, move, reorder and disconnect nodes through controls.
cases.expected_outcome: The same document commands and validation apply as on the canvas.

cases.title: Known shape mismatch
cases.setup: Dot-product inputs have lengths 200 and 256.
cases.expected_outcome: Known mismatch is identified with both dimensions; no implicit reshape.

cases.title: Symbolic dimension
cases.setup: An input length is symbolic n.
cases.expected_outcome: Unresolved equality is requires_check; no invented n value.

cases.title: Exact-to-numeric cast
cases.setup: Exact rational data targets a floating-only port.
cases.expected_outcome: Conversion is rejected or explicitly inserted from a registered operation after review.

cases.title: Finite-field representation
cases.setup: Two field inputs have incompatible representation identifiers.
cases.expected_outcome: The UI does not equate them by label; host-supported conversion/rebinding is required.

cases.title: Ordered variadic inputs
cases.setup: A collection port declares ordering.
cases.expected_outcome: Declared input order changes explicitly and invalidates the mathematical revision; geometry is irrelevant.

cases.title: Context mismatch
cases.setup: Inputs have conflicting domain or unit context.
cases.expected_outcome: Host obligation/diagnostic is shown; the browser does not merge assumptions silently.

cases.title: Requiredness is not guessed
cases.setup: Legacy hints omit required fields.
cases.expected_outcome: Coverage is disclosed; unspecified requiredness remains host-validated.

cases.title: Default versus omission
cases.setup: Schema defines a default but omission has host meaning.
cases.expected_outcome: Opening the form does not turn the default into explicit user input.

cases.title: Hostile schema reference
cases.setup: A schema references an arbitrary network URL.
cases.expected_outcome: No external fetch occurs; unresolved reference is reported.

cases.title: No eval validator
cases.setup: CSP disallows eval and runtime function construction.
cases.expected_outcome: Known validators/subset work without unsafe-eval; unsupported checks defer to host.

cases.title: KaTeX hostile input
cases.setup: Expression contains unsafe commands, oversized layout and recursive macros.
cases.expected_outcome: Limits apply; no active HTML/network loading; errors are escaped and isolated.

cases.title: Matrix paste review
cases.setup: Clipboard has ragged rows and mixed decimal separators.
cases.expected_outcome: Preview identifies interpretation/errors before binding; no formula execution or silent cell conversion.

cases.title: Fragment insertion inert
cases.setup: Fragment includes valid and unavailable operations.
cases.expected_outcome: IDs remap, missing bindings are explicit, and no host execution occurs.

cases.title: Fragment update isolation
cases.setup: Several documents used an older fragment copy.
cases.expected_outcome: Existing documents do not mutate; updating requires an explicit diff-and-replace action.

cases.title: Collapse warning retention
cases.setup: Group contains invalid input and a cleanup warning.
cases.expected_outcome: Aggregated warning remains visible and navigable.

cases.title: GPU frame inertness
cases.setup: A visual frame is labelled GPU.
cases.expected_outcome: No engine/target change occurs from geometry or label alone.

cases.title: Unsupported loop
cases.setup: Imported graph contains a loop/control operation the host does not advertise.
cases.expected_outcome: Node stays unresolved/unavailable; no JavaScript loop emulates execution.

cases.title: Host subworkflow version
cases.setup: A subworkflow instance refers to version A.
cases.action: Edit its host definition to version B.
cases.expected_outcome: Existing run remains A; draft update requires explicit review and refreshed mapping.

cases.title: Validation scope labels
cases.setup: Editor checks pass but host validation is absent.
cases.expected_outcome: It says editor checks passed, not verified or runnable.

cases.title: Stale validation response
cases.setup: Revision 17 validation returns after editing revision 18.
cases.expected_outcome: It cannot clear current diagnostics; scope/revision is visible.

cases.title: Connected proof node
cases.setup: A graph contains a verifier wired downstream.
cases.expected_outcome: Only planned check/expected support is displayed; no established proof badge.

cases.title: Safe repair choice
cases.setup: Host diagnostic suggests a registered conversion.
cases.expected_outcome: Semantic effect is reviewed and one draft transaction occurs; no hidden run.

cases.title: Unbounded expensive validation
cases.setup: Typing rapidly would trigger costly host validation.
cases.expected_outcome: Requests are bounded/debounced or manual; no unbounded mathematical work is hidden in keystrokes.

cases.title: Unsupported cycle
cases.setup: A cyclic draft is imported into an acyclic-only host.
cases.expected_outcome: Cycle stays inspectable with blocking diagnostic; no edge is silently removed.

cases.title: Plan digest binding
cases.setup: Host returns immutable plan for draft revision 12.
cases.expected_outcome: Only that host plan/authority reference is sent, not a later mutable draft.

cases.title: Plan-expiry race
cases.setup: Plan expires while review is open.
cases.expected_outcome: Host rejection is shown; UI does not renew approval automatically.

cases.title: Semantic edit invalidates plan
cases.setup: Target preference or arithmetic precision changes.
cases.expected_outcome: Prior plan is marked obsolete; fresh host planning is required.

cases.title: Run overlay revision
cases.setup: Revision 12 is running while revision 13 is edited.
cases.expected_outcome: Each overlay identifies its frozen revision; old success is not shown as current draft success.

cases.title: Scope preview
cases.setup: Selected output requires host-resolved predecessors.
cases.expected_outcome: Review shows exact resolved scope; unsupported scope is unavailable.

cases.title: Target as property
cases.setup: A workflow has a GPU-preferred operation.
cases.expected_outcome: Engine/target remain separate properties; no fictitious GPU mathematical node appears.

cases.title: No browser scheduler
cases.setup: A three-node workflow is submitted to a capable host.
cases.expected_outcome: One host workflow submission occurs; UI never dispatches predecessors/successors individually.

cases.title: Mutation retry disabled
cases.setup: Submission response is lost after acceptance.
cases.action: Allow network/query retries and component remounts.
cases.expected_outcome: No blind second submission; UI correlates existing request through host.

cases.title: Close browser independence
cases.setup: A real host run is active.
cases.expected_outcome: Host continues owning run; UI reconstructs state without replaying actions.

cases.title: HTTP abort not cancel
cases.setup: A status or preview request is aborted.
cases.expected_outcome: Only request cancellation is shown; backend computation is not declared stopped.

cases.title: Live preview off by default
cases.setup: A heavy parameter is controlled by a slider.
cases.expected_outcome: Only draft changes occur unless a separate bounded host preview session is enabled.

cases.title: Standalone is not workflow fallback
cases.setup: Workflow support is unavailable but operation invocation works.
cases.expected_outcome: Action remains unavailable; UI does not chain standalone requests.

cases.title: Snapshot watermark race
cases.setup: Events arrive between snapshot creation and subscription.
cases.expected_outcome: No event gap; host replay or resnapshot establishes current state.

cases.title: Duplicate event
cases.setup: Same event ID is delivered twice.
cases.expected_outcome: One effective state update; no duplicate results or attempts.

cases.title: Out-of-order revision
cases.setup: Lower entity revision arrives after a newer terminal state.
cases.expected_outcome: Newer state remains authoritative; old data cannot revert it.

cases.title: Expired cursor
cases.setup: Event retention no longer includes saved cursor.
cases.expected_outcome: Fresh snapshot is requested; missing events are not invented.

cases.title: Authentication expires
cases.setup: Session loses permission during an active stream.
cases.expected_outcome: Private fetches stop, sensitive previews are cleared per policy, no mutations replay.

cases.title: Host-switch late response
cases.setup: Host A response arrives after switching to B.
cases.expected_outcome: Scope mismatch is rejected; A data never enters B state.

cases.title: Trust versus status
cases.setup: Result has trust numeric and semantic_status verified_numeric.
cases.expected_outcome: Both fields remain distinct; no new verified_numeric trust level is invented.

cases.title: Candidate formal spoof
cases.setup: Raw candidate text claims formal and verified=true.
cases.expected_outcome: Persistent unverified-candidate treatment; claims stay untrusted metadata.

cases.title: Partial claim support
cases.setup: Host establishes feasibility but not global optimality.
cases.expected_outcome: Summary preserves the unresolved claim; whole result is not called globally optimal.

cases.title: Independent certificate
cases.setup: Host admits an independent local proof for remotely found candidate.
cases.expected_outcome: Valid admitted claim is retained; remote origin is not indiscriminately used to downgrade it.

cases.title: Approximate ancestry
cases.setup: Exact downstream arithmetic used rounded source data.
cases.expected_outcome: Approximate-input ancestry and conditional scope remain visible.

cases.title: Verifier timeout
cases.setup: Host reports inconclusive verification due to resource limit.
cases.expected_outcome: Not shown as disproved, failed mathematics, or established proof.

cases.title: Receipt is not result
cases.setup: Output budget returns resource receipt with original_trust metadata.
cases.expected_outcome: UI fetches authorized result pages; receipt cannot create accepted evidence.

cases.title: Partial page loading
cases.setup: Only part of a large result is available.
cases.expected_outcome: Partial coverage is explicit; unseen assumptions/errors are not treated as absent.

cases.title: Expired result resource
cases.setup: Host returns unknown_or_expired_resource.
cases.expected_outcome: Expiry is displayed; no automatic recomputation or mathematical-failure claim.

cases.title: Exact table copy
cases.setup: Table contains large exact integers.
cases.expected_outcome: Exact text survives; display truncation does not affect copied canonical value.

cases.title: Page-only sort
cases.setup: Only 100 of many rows are loaded.
cases.expected_outcome: UI says loaded-page sorting, not whole-dataset sorting.

cases.title: Candidate admission transition
cases.setup: An artifact was previously candidate-only.
cases.action: Receive a distinct accepted host result reference.
cases.expected_outcome: Badge changes only with authenticated admitted result and bound claim identity.

cases.title: Untrusted HTML
cases.setup: Artifact contains scripts, forms and network requests.
cases.expected_outcome: It stays inert or scripts-disabled; never executes on parent origin.

cases.title: SVG injection
cases.setup: Image-labelled SVG contains active elements.
cases.expected_outcome: No direct unsafe insertion into parent DOM; safe media path/fallback used.

cases.title: Forged viewer command
cases.setup: An iframe sends a message requesting Run or grant change.
cases.expected_outcome: Message is rejected; no privileged host request occurs.

cases.title: Opaque-origin channel spoof
cases.setup: Unrelated frame sends origin-null message with wrong nonce/source.
cases.expected_outcome: Strict frame/channel/artifact binding rejects it.

cases.title: Viewer network confinement
cases.setup: Supported active viewer attempts nonallowlisted fetch/navigation.
cases.expected_outcome: Browser policies and fixed renderer reject the attempt; credentials remain unavailable.

cases.title: Viewer crash isolation
cases.setup: WebGL context fails repeatedly.
cases.expected_outcome: Recoverable fallback appears; editor survives; no infinite recreation or resource leak.

cases.title: Display versus recompute
cases.setup: Viewer has camera and sampling-range controls.
cases.expected_outcome: Camera is view-only; changed sampling requires explicit host production request.

cases.title: Information-loss label
cases.setup: Projection is sampled and quantized.
cases.expected_outcome: Source identity and loss labels remain visible; rendering does not upgrade evidence.

cases.title: Audio user action
cases.setup: A sonification artifact is selected.
cases.expected_outcome: No autoplay, microphone access, speech trigger, or transcription starts.

cases.title: Audio disposal
cases.setup: Audio and one 3D viewer are active.
cases.expected_outcome: Contexts, buffers, URLs and listeners are disposed; host generation cancellation is not falsely claimed.

cases.title: Linked source selection
cases.setup: Artifact provides only partial source-event mapping.
cases.expected_outcome: Only known table/audio matches highlight; missing links are disclosed.

cases.title: Use selection as input
cases.setup: A viewer selection would create new mathematical input.
cases.expected_outcome: Explicit draft binding/transformation and host validation occur; display state is not silently fed to a solver.

cases.title: Uncertain price
cases.setup: Plan quote omits egress and final tax information.
cases.expected_outcome: Unknown/excluded components and native currency are explicit; no guaranteed cap is invented.

cases.title: Unsupported hard cap
cases.setup: Host says hard_spend_cap_supported=false.
cases.expected_outcome: UI shows host rejection; runtime deadline is not presented as a monetary guarantee.

cases.title: Export ancestor disclosure
cases.setup: Selected root has restricted transitive inputs.
cases.expected_outcome: Host-resolved closure/classification is shown; root-only approval cannot hide ancestors.

cases.title: Challenge plan mismatch
cases.setup: Approval challenge belongs to older plan digest.
cases.expected_outcome: Confirmation is rejected/disabled; no stale authority is reused.

cases.title: Enter key carry-through
cases.setup: User submits text with Enter just before approval modal opens.
cases.expected_outcome: A deliberate separate confirmation is required; modal is not auto-approved.

cases.title: Imported approval assertion
cases.setup: Graph JSON contains approved=true or grant secret.
cases.expected_outcome: Prohibited authority is rejected/quarantined; no trusted confirmation state is created.

cases.title: Ready result unresolved resource
cases.setup: Host reports accepted result and cleanup_unknown.
cases.expected_outcome: Both facts remain visible; persistent global warning survives closing graph.

cases.title: Cancel acknowledgement only
cases.setup: Host accepts cancel but has not observed stop.
cases.expected_outcome: UI says requested/pending, not stopped or billing ended.

cases.title: Unknown usage
cases.setup: Provider final cost is unavailable.
cases.expected_outcome: Unknown is displayed, never zero.

cases.title: Existing user-owned target
cases.setup: Host says resource ownership is not_owned.
cases.expected_outcome: No machine termination action is inferred; job-level scope is preserved.

cases.title: Legacy job missing axes
cases.setup: Old local job API has only queued/running/done/failed.
cases.expected_outcome: Unreported verification/resource/cost fields remain not reported; guarantees are not fabricated.

cases.title: Retry scope
cases.setup: Failed job retry needs a new host authorization.
cases.expected_outcome: UI follows host review/approval; prior grant is not reset or expanded locally.

cases.title: Storage quota failure
cases.setup: IndexedDB write fails.
cases.action: Edit a draft and trigger autosave.
cases.expected_outcome: Visible recovery warning and export fallback; UI does not say saved.

cases.title: Memory-only policy
cases.setup: Workspace forbids browser persistence of inputs.
cases.expected_outcome: No sensitive recovery is written; limitation is disclosed before relying on recovery.

cases.title: Host save conflict
cases.setup: Remote revision changed since loading.
cases.expected_outcome: Both versions are preserved and diff offered; no unconditional overwrite.

cases.title: Two-tab edits
cases.setup: Two tabs edit the same host document.
cases.expected_outcome: Awareness may warn; host revision control remains authoritative.

cases.title: Recovery no replay
cases.setup: Recovery record includes pending run references.
cases.expected_outcome: Only read-only host resolution occurs; no preview/run/approval replay.

cases.title: Delete distinctions
cases.setup: A graph has a local recovery copy and a past remote run.
cases.expected_outcome: Run/resources/artifacts are unaffected; deletion scope is explicit.

cases.title: Duplicate JSON keys
cases.setup: Document repeats a critical property.
cases.expected_outcome: Parser rejects ambiguity before any host action.

cases.title: Prototype-key payload
cases.setup: Document includes prototype-related malicious keys.
cases.expected_outcome: Strict schema/safe mapping rejects them; object prototypes are unchanged.

cases.title: Document size/depth caps
cases.setup: Input exceeds proposed size or nesting limit.
cases.expected_outcome: Clean bounded refusal with original file untouched; UI remains responsive.

cases.title: Unknown major version
cases.setup: Editor document declares mk.studio/99.
cases.expected_outcome: No guessed migration or execution; safe unsupported-version explanation.

cases.title: No secrets in export
cases.setup: Session has private URLs and a current approval challenge.
cases.expected_outcome: Output contains neither credentials nor authority/session material nor live trusted status claims.

cases.title: Export mode distinction
cases.setup: User has draft, existing artifact and host replay capability.
cases.expected_outcome: Editor/view/artifact/replay actions are clearly distinct and none silently reruns mathematics.

cases.title: Cross-origin mutation
cases.setup: Unrelated web origin targets local host.
cases.expected_outcome: Host authentication/origin/CSRF protections reject it; client-only disabling is not sufficient.

cases.title: DNS/host mismatch
cases.setup: Request uses unexpected Host or origin binding.
cases.expected_outcome: Configured host identity policy rejects unauthorized route/rebinding.

cases.title: No token persistence
cases.setup: Authenticated session and approvals exist.
cases.action: Inspect storage, URL, exports and logs.
cases.expected_outcome: No reusable auth/provider/grant secrets are present.

cases.title: CSP production build
cases.setup: Built app uses real canvas, math preview and isolated viewer.
cases.expected_outcome: No unsafe-eval/script broadening is required; style exceptions are narrow and documented.

cases.title: Imported host URL
cases.setup: Graph refers to an attacker-selected host.
cases.action: Import while authenticated to local host.
cases.expected_outcome: No automatic contact and no forwarding of existing credentials.

cases.title: No telemetry by default
cases.setup: Full user journey is exercised with network recording.
cases.expected_outcome: Only explicitly selected host/assets are contacted; no analytics/session replay/CDN service appears.

cases.title: Screen-reader journey
cases.setup: A documented screen reader is enabled.
cases.action: Discover, connect, repair, review and inspect a result.
cases.expected_outcome: Operation/port names, assumptions and candidate/evidence distinctions are understandable without geometry/color.

cases.title: Non-drag pointer journey
cases.setup: Dragging is unavailable but clicking works.
cases.expected_outcome: Every essential drag operation has a click-based equivalent; keyboard-only alternative alone is insufficient.

cases.title: Focus obscuration
cases.setup: Sticky header/drawer and approval dialog are open.
cases.action: Navigate with keyboard and reveal diagnostic fields.
cases.expected_outcome: Focused controls stay visible, focus restores correctly, and warnings do not steal it.

cases.title: Zoom and target size
cases.setup: UI is zoomed and high contrast/reduced motion is enabled.
cases.expected_outcome: Controls remain accessible with adequate hit areas; animation is not required for meaning.

cases.title: Localized input and labels
cases.setup: Dutch UI and long translated status labels are loaded.
cases.expected_outcome: Canonical values remain stable; consequential labels/warnings are not hidden by truncation.

cases.title: Clock skew
cases.setup: Browser clock is wrong and plan expiry is near.
cases.expected_outcome: Countdown is qualified; host expiry decides validity, not browser time.

cases.title: Catalog search budget
cases.setup: 2,000-entry authorized fixture on reference laptop.
cases.expected_outcome: Record p95 against proposed 150-ms budget; report misses rather than claim measured compliance.

cases.title: Medium graph interaction
cases.setup: 200 nodes/400 edges with real node shells.
cases.expected_outcome: Record frame and inspector latency with environment details; no hidden viewer simplification in report.

cases.title: Large draft graceful view
cases.setup: 1,000 nodes/2,000 edges.
cases.expected_outcome: Outline becomes usable progressively; no nodes are dropped from saved content.

cases.title: Event burst memory
cases.setup: Sustained progress/log burst for 10 minutes.
cases.expected_outcome: Memory is bounded; important state/cleanup transitions are retained; coalescing is explicit.

cases.title: Viewer disposal trend
cases.setup: Repeatedly open/close audio and 3D artifacts.
cases.expected_outcome: Resources return toward baseline; no unbounded listeners, buffers or object URLs.

cases.title: Cancelled parse/layout
cases.setup: Large valid editor import or layout runs in worker.
cases.expected_outcome: UI remains responsive; previous document/layout survives; no mathematical command is cancelled or retried.

cases.title: Clean offline installation
cases.setup: Release artifact on machine without npm/Node runtime.
cases.action: Install optional UI and open it offline with local host.
cases.expected_outcome: Required bundled assets work; base install remains independent.

cases.title: Nested route and base path
cases.setup: App is served under a nonroot configured path.
cases.expected_outcome: Correct app and scoped entity load; route reload does not invoke a command.

cases.title: Mixed asset versions
cases.setup: Cached old index points to removed build assets.
cases.expected_outcome: Clear recovery/version screen; no incompatible silent mutation.

cases.title: Real local end-to-end
cases.setup: An actual MathKernel host supplies an advertised standalone operation/result.
cases.action: Run explicit input and inspect result/evidence.
cases.expected_outcome: Record real result parity and actual tests; fixture-only proof is insufficient.

cases.title: Real workflow gate
cases.setup: A separately supplied real workflow-capable host is available.
cases.action: Submit frozen graph, close browser, reconnect, inspect result.
cases.expected_outcome: Host owns execution/recovery; mapping/evidence match revision; otherwise feature stays blocked.

cases.title: Support matrix evidence
cases.setup: Browser/accessibility/integration checks have mixed actual outcomes.
cases.expected_outcome: Exact tested versions and pass/fail/skip/blocked status are reported; untested browsers/providers are not claimed supported.
